name: graveyard-hollow
title: Graveyard Hollow
summary: Keep the village lanterns lit until dawn while a friend blows them out.
description:
Graveyard Hollow is a social deduction party game for 4 to 10 players. At night the villagers keep the lanterns burning and finish their chores, while one or two secret Hollow snuff the lights and take villagers in the dark. Find a friend's empty lantern, ring the bell, argue it out, and vote.

- Play on your local network, each on your own device, or online through a LinuxGroove game server
- Fill empty seats with bots; with enough memory they think and talk in meetings using a small language model that runs on your own machine (embedded Lemonade Server, downloaded on first use)
- Made for controllers and handhelds, fully playable with a keyboard
